title: A Lake with Eleven Boats on It
subtitle: 江河湖海 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）
meta: 主题语境：江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）　|　核心词汇：water　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 water 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The ① water in that lake is eleven metres deep at the middle and it has never frozen, and my grandfather said the reason is that it is fed from below, which nobody believed and which turned out to be true. The ② water, meaning the surface, was where he spent thirty-one years: he never once went under it, and he said a man who does not know what is under him should stay on top.

The ③ waters he fished were eleven miles of the same shore, and he knew every yard of them; in 1968 the county said he could not fish two of those miles, and he fished them anyway and was fined eleven times. He ④ watered nothing in his life, not a plant, and my grandmother said a man who will not water a plant will not water a child either, and she was not wrong.

In 1971 his mouth ⑤ watered at the sight of the first ones of the year, which is what he said, and I have never forgotten the sentence. In 1974 the whole village was ⑥ under water for eleven days, and he went out in a boat he had made himself, brought eleven people back, and never said a word about it afterwards.

In 1979 he was ⑦ in deep water with the council over a licence, and he lost, and for eleven years afterwards he went everywhere ⑧ by water, which is possible in that county in a way it is not in most, and which he said was the whole point of living there.

The ⑨ water, meaning the lake itself, was sold in 1989 to a man from the city, who put eleven boats on it, and my grandfather said a lake with eleven boats on it is a car park. The ⑩ water he cared about, in the end, was not the lake: it was the eleven inches of it in a glass beside his bed, which he could see from the chair and which he did not drink for thirty-one years.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: C. n. （某处的）水域；海域（常用复数 waters）
E. v. 流口水；淌口水
F. 固定搭配：under water 在水下；被水淹没
G. 固定搭配：in deep water 陷入困境；麻烦缠身
H. 固定搭配：by water 走水路；乘船

items.q: The water in that lake is eleven metres
The waters he fished were eleven miles
He watered nothing in his life
his mouth watered at the sight
the whole village was under water
he was in deep water with the council
The water, meaning the lake itself
The water he cared about, in the end

answers.why: the water 意为“水、湖水”，那个湖中央的水有十一米深，而且从未结过冰。
the water 意为“水面”，他三十一年都在水面上度过，从未下到水下。
waters 意为“水域”，他捕鱼的那一带水域是同一段湖岸的十一英里。
watered 是动词，意为“给……浇水”，他一生什么也没浇过，连一棵植物也没有。
watered 意为“流口水”，1971 年他看到当年第一批鱼时直流口水——这是他自己的原话。
under water 意为“被水淹没”，1974 年整个村子被水淹了十一天。
in deep water 意为“陷入困境、麻烦缠身”，1979 年他为了一张执照与议会闹得不可开交。
by water 意为“走水路、乘船”，此后十一年他去哪儿都走水路。
the water 意为“（这片）水、湖”，1989 年这片湖被卖给了一个城里人。
the water 意为“水”，他最终在意的水不是那个湖，而是床边杯子里那十一英寸的水。
